limitations: Additive TLS/gRPC feature in the existing DNA service for synthetic Puregene/DNeasy, NanoDrop, Qubit and TapeStation only; no physical device commands.
The existing integrated root remains the only owner of material identities, quantities, reservations, original artifacts and atomic network receipts.
Authentication, request acceptance, cancellation and transport leases do not prove physical effects or release laboratory resources.
Only named pinned families and fixed synthetic fixtures are exposed; no generic Act, device-confirmation, time-advance, dilution or arbitrary profile-path endpoint.
Source changes fence active runs without silent journal migration; uncertain effects require explicit versioned reconciliation and are never replayed.
No physical chemistry, liquid handling, qualified SOP, native instrument export, robot motion, hardware safety, LAN qualification or formal SiLA certification.
Archived standard features and LockController v1.0 remain unchanged; the old DNA feature retains its own v1 wire surface.
Private server pause points are test injections, never public network command parameters.
